subject: RDMA: Fix dead loop when transfer large data (20KB) (#1386)
reason: The change is confined to src/rdma.c: it implements the already-existing postpone_update_state/update_state connection hooks for the RDMA transport to fix a dead loop on large (~20KB) transfers. That code is compiled only with BUILD_RDMA and executes only for clients connected over an RDMA channel, which needs RDMA hardware or root-level soft-RoCE kernel setup, an --rdma-port, and an RDMA-capable client.
